title: Rest And Still Rise (Long Version)
style: soul with a two-part arc, brooding 62-68 bpm opening lifting to an upbeat 100-112 bpm groove at the turn, warm piano and round bass foundation, percussion thickening as it lifts, triumphant horn stabs and claps from the turnaround, hopeful minor-to-major resolution, close dry upfront vocal, single continuous take. Warm female lead, sung melody with long held open vowels, rising in register after the turn. The lead SPEAKS the lines tagged Spoken in a plain natural voice over the music, and SINGS the lines tagged Sung with long held notes. Only the short intro and the final outro are spoken; the full band keeps playing continuously under them, natural resolved ending, final chord rings out and fades.
negative_tags: rap, rapping, choir, reverb, echo, band dropout, acapella sections, talk-singing, monotone delivery

kie_params.duration: delivered seconds (L-2); G9 headroom question is open decision 3 in file 18

segments.lyrics:
[Intro (spoken): close dry voice, plain speech, no melody]
Two in the morning, and I am running on empty.

[Vocalise (sung): wordless, full melodic voice, two very long held notes]
Ooh-oo-ooh, ooh-oo-ooh

[Verse 1 (sung): melodic, rhymed, slow long held notes]
The alarm rings at fi-ive,
I'm barely half a-alive,
I rise before the su-un,
the coffee's barely do-one,
I pack the lunches ti-ight,
I'm on the train by li-ight,

[Hook (sung): full melody, sustained notes, slow long held notes]
You can rest and still ri-i-ise

[Verse 2 (sung): melodic, rhymed, slow long held notes]
I answer every ca-all,
I'm holding up the wa-all,
The laundry never e-ends,
I cancel on my frie-ends,
They called my name out lou-oud,
I froze before the crow-owd,

[Hook (sung): full melody, sustained notes, slow long held notes]
You can rest and still ri-i-ise

[Instrumental Break: band only, no vocals]

[Verse 3 (sung): melodic, rhymed, slow long held notes]
The bills stack on the ta-able,
I smile like I am a-able,
I tell them I am fi-ine,
I'm fraying at the li-ine,
Two in the morning, sti-ill,
I cannot climb this hi-ill,

[Pre-Hook (sung): melodic, rhymed, slow long held notes]
The doctor said slow dow-own,
I nodded, wore my frow-own,
My mother did it, too-oo,
she never rested throu-ough,

[Hook (sung): full melody, sustained notes, slow long held notes]
You can rest and still ri-i-ise

[Verse 4 (sung): melodic, rhymed, slow long held notes]
My daughter saw my fa-ace,
she saw me lose my pla-ace,
I missed her school play ni-ight,
I told myself all ri-ight,
The mirror looked so gre-ey,
I didn't know the wa-ay,

[Hook (sung): full melody, sustained notes, slow long held notes]
You can rest and still ri-i-ise

[Verse 5 (sung): melodic, rhymed, slow long held notes]
I bought the planners, too-oo,
I swore that I'd push throu-ough,
I thought that rest was wea-eak,
I thought that tired was mee-eek,
The car, the desk, the sto-ove,
no room for any lo-ove,

[End]

[Instrumental Break: band only, no vocals]

[Build (sung): melodic, rising, tempo lifting]
A friend sat by my si-ide,
she said, you need not hi-ide,
She read a line to me-e,
about the right to be-e,

[Product (sung): melodic, warm, clear diction on the name]
She handed me a bo-ook,
The Unhurried Year, look,
Each page said slow and sta-ay,
I read it every single da-ay,
I took the book to be-ed,
I heard what Dana sa-aid,

[Hook (sung): full melody, upbeat groove, full voice]
You can rest and still ri-i-ise

[Verse 6 (sung): melodic, rhymed, slow long held notes]
I wondered, is this ri-ight?
Can rest be how I fi-ight?
Rest is not quitting, no-o,
it's how I learned to gro-ow,

[Hook (sung): full melody, upbeat groove, full voice]
You can rest and still ri-i-ise

[End]

[Instrumental Break: band only, no vocals]

[Product (reprise) (sung): melodic, warm, clear diction on the name]
The Unhurried Year I keep,
the night I learned to slee-eep,
It taught me how to sta-ay,
and let the rush give wa-ay,
One chapter every ni-ight,
my mornings turned out ri-ight,

[Hook (sung): full melody, upbeat groove, full voice]
You can rest and still ri-i-ise

[Verse 7 (sung): melodic, rhymed, slow long held notes]
I slowed my mornings dow-own,
I laid the heavy crow-own,
One quiet cup of te-ea,
one hour just for me-e,
I said no to a fa-vor,
my mornings got their fla-vor,

[Hook (sung): full melody, upbeat groove, full voice]
You can rest and still ri-i-ise

[Bridge (sung): upbeat groove, rising]
No more running on empty-y,
no more proving I am wo-orthy,

[Hook (sung): full melody, upbeat groove, full voice]
You can rest and still ri-i-ise

[End]

[Instrumental Break: band only, no vocals]

[Verse 8 (sung): melodic, rhymed, slow long held notes]
My work got sharp and cle-ear,
my boss leaned in to he-ear,
My house is calm and free-ee,
my daughter smiles at me-e,
My daughter's laughing lou-oud,
I'm standing tall and prou-oud,

[Hook (sung): full melody, upbeat groove, full voice]
You can rest and still ri-i-ise

[Product (reprise 2) (sung): melodic, warm, clear diction on the name]
The Unhurried Year, my gui-ide,
it sits right by my si-ide,

[Verse 9 (sung): melodic, rhymed, slow long held notes]
The bills are on a pla-an,
I'm doing what I ca-an,
I sleep the whole night throu-ough,
the morning feels brand new-ew,
I'm softer and I'm stro-ong,
I knew it all alo-ong,

[Hook (sung): full melody, upbeat groove, full voice]
You can rest and still ri-i-ise

[Bridge 2 (sung): half-time, stripped back, sustained]
So if you're running thi-in,
let rest come gently i-in,

[Hook (sung): full melody, upbeat groove, full voice]
You can rest and still ri-i-ise

[Outro (spoken): calm close voice, plain speech, no melody]
The Unhurried Year by Dana Wells gave me my mornings back. Rest is not quitting. Get the book today.

[End]
